History of the records of one key

Source: R/journal.R
fm_journal_history.Rd

Useful to check that a correction was taken into account, or to compare two passes over the same specimen.

Usage

fm_journal_history(journal_dir, row_key = NULL)

Arguments

journal_dir

Journal directory, or an already-read data.frame.

row_key

Key to inspect. NULL -> summary of every key.
